pattern.top_pattern: IN Family Care pressure points to episode and LTCH economics around AMG
pattern.what_is_impacting: IN Family Care ACUTE HOSPITAL and LONG TERM CARE HOSPITAL admissions

providers: AMG SPECIALTY HOSPITAL CENTRAL INDIANA - MUNCIE

key_driver_codes: AMG SPECIALTY HOSPITAL CENTRAL INDIANA - MUNCIE
Major Small and Large Bowel Procedures with CC
pattern.pattern_details: IN Family Care spend is rising through a combination of more acute hospital admissions and higher-cost LTCH episodes tied to AMG SPECIALTY HOSPITAL CENTRAL INDIANA - MUNCIE. Acute hospital growth is mostly volume-driven in major bowel procedures, while LTCH adds a smaller but more expensive setting. The pattern suggests episode economics and transfer behavior deserve focused review.
pattern.why_it_matters: Episodes that extend into LTCH can materially increase spend even when acute paid per admit is stable or falling.
pattern.recommended_next_step: Complete a provider-level episode review for Family Care cases involving AMG and related acute stays to assess transfer patterns, medical necessity, and LTCH reimbursement terms.
evidence_summary: IN Family Care ACUTE HOSPITAL adds about +$0.4M in Major Small and Large Bowel Procedures with CC with 17 more admissions.
AMG SPECIALTY HOSPITAL CENTRAL INDIANA - MUNCIE adds about +$173K in LONG TERM CARE HOSPITAL stays on 7 admissions with about +$24.7K higher paid per admit.
